blockers.name: Preview Origin CORS Rejection on api.islamic.app
blockers.description: https://api.islamic.app rejects requests from origin http://15.235.203.134:9998 with missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin header, causing prayer times and online hadith fetches to fail on the web preview.
blockers.impact: Web client displays offline / retry error states when attempting remote API fetches.
blockers.workaround: App falls back cleanly to local bundled offline data (surahs114, names99, fallback hadiths).

blockers.name: LocationSetupModal First-Launch Overlay
blockers.description: When location-setup-dismissed-v1 is missing, LocationSetupModal overlays UI after splash, blocking navigation until dismissed or city selected.
blockers.impact: Automated clicks on top-level tabs can be intercepted by modal overlay.

blockers.name: Plain HTTP Insecure Web Context
blockers.description: Preview served over plain HTTP disables navigator.serviceWorker and CacheStorage registration in modern Chromium browsers.
blockers.impact: Web PWA offline caching cannot be registered.
